misprint of ସଂହିତାୟାଂ, in the Samhita
of one who wishes to create
of those who hate the gods
here it is held in the heart
cloud-Svati (a name of the star Svati)
one who marries after his younger brother
in the radiance of the limbs
born in the line of Angiras
as if not knowing one another
on the path, taking the feet of the great one
in the Self without name and form
by the grace of Mahavishnu, unobstructed movement
asked the sages of various duties
awaited for this one also, as if expected
looked upon with eyes blind with tears of love
one who is not a yogi in mind
having ten thousand years of life
of the one with ten thousand years of life
having received the honoured welcome without grass, earth and other things
of those whose impurities are unripe
in the form of a horse
of the haters of demons? (of those who hate asuras)
I alone was in the beginning
